title: GraphNodesRow
description: One row of graph.nodes: a node of the service dependency graph with its kind, entry flag and evidence sources. Produced by Causalith (03 §6.1, 05 §3.1-§3.3).

node.description: Service name, or an external host (lowercase, without port) seen in client spans that does not normalise to a known service (contract_changes B; 05 §3.1).

kind.description: Node kind; first matching rule wins: entry, cache, db, queue, external, service (05 §3.2).

is_entry.description: True if the node receives external traffic, by the shared entry-service rule (05 §3.3).

provenance.description: Sources the node was seen in: traces (spans/edges), topology (named in an event hint), logs (source or target of a counted log mention), metrics (has a metrics series). Unique, sorted, may be empty (contract_changes B; 05 §3.1).
